get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for the Fal AI Imagen4 model
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation parameters to Fal AI Imagen4 parameter format
transform_image_generation_request: transform an OpenAI-style image generation request into a Fal AI Imagen4 request body
transform_image_generation_response: transform a Fal AI Imagen4 HTTP response into a standardized litellm ImageResponse object
map_aspect_ratio: map an OpenAI size string like 1024x768 to an Imagen4 aspect ratio string like 4:3
